description: Note a design decision in PROJECT.md as one dated line, as ONE change: each choice a later context should not undo (a part and why, a board size, what the person approved). open: true adds the text to Open instead (still to do or ask). Or sections alone: rewrite intent (at most 2000 characters), blocks (at most 50 { name, does, status }) and open (at most 50 non-empty strings) as ONE change; sections not given and Decisions stay.
name: note_decision
